suggestions.rationale: Endocrine and metabolic dysfunction may be associated with peripheral nerve abnormalities in some clinical contexts. Individual examination and electrodiagnostic findings are needed to determine whether that relationship applies.
evidenceGaps: Monofilament examination or nerve conduction studies

sourceReferences.note: Peripheral nerve rating schedule; does not establish a medical relationship between the underlying conditions.

suggestions.rationale: Metabolic dysfunction may be associated with microvascular changes affecting the eye in relevant clinical populations. Individual ophthalmologic findings and diagnosis are required to determine whether this relationship applies.

sourceReferences.note: Eye rating schedule; does not establish a medical relationship between the underlying conditions.

suggestions.rationale: Metabolic and hypertensive factors may be associated with impaired renal filtration over time. Individual laboratory trends and clinical assessment are required to determine whether this relationship applies.
evidenceGaps: eGFR and eCr lab trends over 3+ months

sourceReferences.note: Renal rating schedule; does not establish a medical relationship between the underlying conditions.
